description: This file provides a lightweight internationalization (i18n) utility for a web application. It defines supported languages, functions to get and set the stored language preference in localStorage, and translation bundles for English, Hindi, and Telugu. It includes functions to retrieve the current language's translation for a given key, with fallbacks to English. The bundles contain localized strings used across the application's UI.

methods.name: getStoredLang()
methods.description: Returns the persisted language code from localStorage or defaults to 'en'.

methods.name: setStoredLang(code)
methods.description: Stores the given language code into localStorage.

methods.name: getDefaultLang()
methods.description: Returns the persisted language code if available, otherwise defaults to 'en'.

methods.name: t
methods.description: Translates a given key based on the specified language code, falling back to English or the key itself if translation is missing.
